thread:
maya: Heads up — vendor AeroPack reports 14x H100 inbound to FRA on AWB AP-774411 flagged by customs. Broker says invoice lists 'RMA' but vendor marked as 'commercial replacement' elsewhere. Hold until clarified.
frank: We need 10 for the EU capacity ramp on Monday. How bad is the hold? ETA unknown until broker confirms.
toni: Forwarder options: (1) Provide corrected commercial invoice with HS=847330 and note 'replacement for warranty' -> broker can usually clear in 24-36h; (2) Refile as formal RMA with supplier's customs RMA cert -> ~48h and extra handling; (3) Air-priority to FRA (~18h) but +$14k. AWB: `AP-774411` tracking: https://carrier.example/AP-774411
maya: vendor-bot, did AeroPack attach any RMA certs or serial DOA notes?
vendor-bot: AeroPack: shipment contains replacement stock (not returned hardware). They provided internal RMA ref AP-RMA-221 but not the customs certificate. Invoice line missing HS code.
frank: Firmware parity issue: EU edge racks require fw v1.4. Can we mix? No for low-latency clusters. Temp pool: EU H100 x5, loaner H100 x1. So short by 4 for rollout.
toni: Proposal: ask vendor to resend corrected invoice (HS 847330 + AP-RMA-221 noted) and commit to $800 broker fee for the fix. Meanwhile front-load 4 H100 from US spares (cross-region transfer) — adds ~36h but keeps rollout on schedule if swap out plan ready.
maya: Finance — can vendor cover $800 handling? If yes, we avoid the $14k air-divert.
logistics-bot: AeroPack emailed corrected invoice draft, agrees to $800 broker handling if Redwood signs acknowledgment. Broker estimates clearance 24-36h after receipt.
frank: OK. I'll reassign non-critical inferencing to H200s and prepare playbook for firmware sync. Create ticket INF-2609 to capture cost authorizations and the cross-region moves.
toni: Signed ack sent to AeroPack. Forwarder requested broker contact: EuroClear Customs <ops@euroclear.example>.
maya: Great coordination. Product — we will tentatively hold the capacity ramp by 24h and confirm once broker confirms clearance.
vendor-bot: Forwarder confirms receipt of corrected invoice; clearance ETA 24-36h. Will update AWB status when released.
